detail.error: The video provider kept throttling submissions (HTTP 429): 2 authorized submission attempt(s) over ~33 minutes all landed inside the same account-wide throttle window, so no generation was ever accepted and no video was produced. The job was not deleted — every attempt is recorded here. BEAN has exactly one authorized video provider (the platform gateway account); a submission can succeed only once its throttle window closes, so a resubmitted job is the way to try again.
